These minimal, sanitized fixtures preserve the observed review formatting from the PR examples supplied during design. Commit IDs and nonessential repository content are replaced or omitted. Other test payloads are synthetic boundary cases, not claims about an agent's documented output contract. `codex-rebased.md` follows a Codex summary observed after a PR was rebased onto a newer base right after opening: the embedded review state and table name the pre-rebase commit.
